title: debark store index v1
description: debark.storeindex/v1 - the content-addressed object store's metadata index: package identity for every object the store holds, so `store ls` and prune can work without opening every .deb. Written as index.json at the store root. Internal to one builder's local store; it never crosses the gap, but is versioned like every other debark document.

entries.description: One entry per object known to the store.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the object's bytes; also its path under sha256/<first two hex chars>/<digest>.

added_at.description: When this object entered the store, RFC 3339 UTC, second precision.

user_supplied.description: True for objects that came from an operator-provided file or URL. Never pruned from a bundle and never garbage-collected without an explicit request.
